mainEntity.name: What can I expect in a typical Boxing Fitness class at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Boxing Fitness classes at Cave Training focus on enhancing cardiovascular endurance, strength, and agility through boxing-inspired workouts. You'll learn fundamental boxing techniques like jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts, combined with conditioning exercises. Classes typically involve warm-ups, shadow boxing, pad work with partners or instructors, and core strengthening, all designed to give you a full-body workout. Beginners are welcome, and instructors demonstrate proper form to prevent injury and maximize effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cave Training's Boxing Fitness classes combine fundamental boxing techniques with conditioning exercises for a full-body workout that builds endurance, strength, and agility.
